name: @ryntra/evidence
description: The evidence layer a Trading Plan's conditions stand on: a metric registry over two providers (market activity over rolling windows, the token's structure at a point in time), a normalized observation with its provenance and times, a condition validator and judge where an unjudgeable rule is never a pass, a rights map read from each provider's terms, a credit-governor contract, the Nansen adapter and the DD.xyz adapter that reserve and settle every call, and the address evidence a recipient check reads. Pure modules plus two thin HTTP clients; no storage, no signing.
author: Dmytro Plavutskyi
